headline: Agreed to send demolition delay ordinance amendments to City Council; named Althea Barton to the Master Plan advisory committee.
summary: Discussed the Master Plan community vision session and the heritage sign program. Seated an alternate member as a voting member and nominated two members to the Planning Board's Master Plan Advisory Committee. Agreed by consensus to move demolition delay ordinance amendments forward to City Council.
decisions: Approved seating Alternate Randall Cotton as a voting member; the motion passed unanimously.
Approved the minutes of the September 3, 2026 regular meeting as submitted.
Recommended removing Section VIII Historic Resources of the Master Plan 2030 from the agenda for future meetings.
Approved nominating Althea Barton as the regular member to the Planning Board's Master Plan Advisory Committee; the motion passed unanimously.
Approved nominating Member Durgy Brooks as alternate to the Planning Board's Master Plan Advisory Committee; the motion passed unanimously.
Agreed by consensus to move forward with the demolition delay ordinance amendments and bring them to City Council.

HERITAGE COMMISSION 
Meeting Minutes - Draft 
October 1, 2026  
 
 
The Heritage Commission held its regular monthly meeting in Council Chambers at 37 Green St, on 
Thursday, October 1, 2026.   
 
Members: Vice-Chair Althea Barton, Carol Durgy Brooks, City Councilor Aislinn Kalob, Dr. Bryant 
Tolles, Jr. and Alternate Member Randall Cotton 
 
Absent:  Chair Richard Jaques, Jim Spain, and Michael Dunn 
 
Staff: Matt Walsh, Deputy City Manager – Community Development 
 Krista Tremblay, Administrative Technician III 
  
 
1. Call to Order 
The meeting was called to order by Vice-Chair Barton at 4:31 p.m. Vice-Chair Barton stated Alternate 
Member Randall Cotton can be a voting member due to the absence of Jim Spain. 
 
Member Durgy Brooks made a motion to seat Alternate Randall Cotton as a voting member due to the 
absence of James Spain. Councilor Kalob seconded. All in favor. The motion passed unanimously. 
 
2. Review / Approval of Minutes 
a. September 3, 2026 Regular Meeting 
Councilor Kalob moved, seconded by Member Durgy Brooks, to accept the Heritage 
Commission minutes from September 3, 2026, as submitted. All in favor. The motion passed.   
 
3. New Business 
a. None 
4. Old/Continuing Business 
a. 210 Bog Road Demolition Update 
There was no discussion on this agenda item. 
  
b. Master Plan Subcommittee Update 
There was no discussion on this agenda item. 
  
c. Review Section VIII Historic Resources of the Master Plan 2030 
Vice-Chair Barton recommended to have this removed from the agenda for future meetings.  
 
d. Monuments and Granite Markers 
There was no discussion on this agenda item. 
 
5. Heritage Sign Program Review Committee update 
Member Durgy Brooks stated there were no new applications submitted by the deadline date and the 
meeting was cancelled. The second workshop was held at the library in September. There were eight
Page 2 of 3 
 
people that attended.  
 
Vice-Chair Barton stated she heard from several members of the community that are excited about the 
heritage sign program.  
 
6. Planning Board Update 
a. Master Plan Update 
i. Re-cap: Community Vision Session Open House on September 19th 
Mr. Walsh asked for feedback from the Commission on the Community Vision Session. 
 
The Commission noted the boards were helpful, interactive and enjoyed the presentation from 
Utile.  
 
Mr. Walsh noted all of the interactive boards and presentation are on the website for people to 
review if they were not able to attend the session. Mr. Walsh noted eventually they will do six 
neighborhood forums, Penacook, East Concord, the Heights, the South End, Downtown, The Hill 
and West Concord, with neighborhood topics.  
 
ii. Nominations of Heritage Commission Members to Planning Board’s Master Plan Advisory 
Subcommittee 
Mr. Walsh stated the Planning Board has appointed a master plan advisory committee.  Mr. 
Walsh provided information attached to the agenda on the Planning Board is looking set up the 
members for the advisory committee. Mr. Walsh read from the attached report on the agenda.   
 
On a motion made by Councilor Kalob to nominate Althea Barton as the Heritage Commission 
regular member for the Planning Board Master Plan Advisory Committee. Member Durgy 
Brooks seconded.   
  
Vice-Chair Barton accepted the nomination.  
 
All in favor. The motion passed unanimously.  
 
Member Durgy Brooks volunteered to be the alternate.  
 
On a motion made by Member Cotton to nominate Member Durgy Brooks as alternate for the 
Planning Board Master Plan Advisory Committee. Councilor Kalob seconded. All in favor. The 
motion passed unanimously. 
 
7. City Council Update 
a. Demolition Delay Ordinance Amendments 
 
Mr. Walsh sated the report to City Council about the demolition delay ordinance amendments has been 
put into a report and filed with the Clerk. The City Council agenda has not been published. Mr. Walsh 
asked for the Commissions feedback on the ordinance amendments. If the Commission is ok with the
Page 3 of 3 
 
amendments it will go before City Council at the October meeting and a public meeting in November to 
receive testimony. 
 
The Commission consensus was to move forward with the amendments to bring to City Council.  
 
8. Other Business 
None. 
 
9. Adjourn 
 
Adjournment 
Member Durgy Brooks moved, seconded by Councilor Kalob, to adjourn the meeting at 5:04 p.m. The 
motion passed unanimously. 
 
Respectfully Submitted,  
Krista Tremblay 
Krista Tremblay 
Administrative Technician III
